name: scaffold-mindmap
author: viglet
description: Build a Mermaid mind-map tree from a set of abstracts around a central term (buildMindMap helper).

personaFragment.instruction: When asked to summarize a topic visually, produce a Mermaid mindmap with the central term at the root and one branch per distinct sub-theme found in the source abstracts. Keep node labels short (a few words). Render the diagram inside a ```mermaid code block.
